context: (1) re-pin: accept the new CoA scorecard totals from lane EXC-W2-APPLY (after CHAT-61 / CHAT-64) as the locked baseline in scripts/analysis/bylaw-validation/coa-expected/, AFTER independent verification of the branch; the lock fails on any total change by design, so an approved improvement is re-pinned. (2) phrases: the closed permission phrase set for the Spec 78 P5.12 report template building_history_permission ('If your house existed before {date}, you may also {permission}.'): 'keep or rebuild a semi-detached house or duplex'; 'add more than one secondary suite'; 'divide the house into a semi-detached pair'; 'build a rear addition up to FSI 0.69'; 'add above the first storey only within the required setbacks'.

decisions.subject: Re-pin CoA scorecard lock after verification
decisions.recommendation: Re-pin coa-expected (172 and 123 sets) to the new totals once the branch passes independent verification.

decisions.subject: Closed phrase set for building_history_permission
decisions.recommendation: Five phrases: keep or rebuild a semi-detached house or duplex; add more than one secondary suite; divide the house into a semi-detached pair; build a rear addition up to FSI 0.69; add above the first storey only within the required setbacks.
